name: projectKleee02
description: Play Kleee02 NFTs on an ILDA laser projector (bundled binary)

scripts.build:win: mkdir -p dist && npx nexe main.js -t windows-x64-16.16.0 -o dist/kleee02-win-x64.exe   --resource "fonts/**/*" --resource "token_*.json" --resource "**/*.node"
scripts.build:linux: mkdir -p dist && npx nexe main.js -t linux-x64-16.16.0   -o dist/kleee02-linux-x64     --resource "fonts/**/*" --resource "token_*.json" --resource "**/*.node"
scripts.build:mac: mkdir -p dist && npx nexe main.js -t mac-x64-16.16.0     -o dist/kleee02-macos-x64     --resource "fonts/**/*" --resource "token_*.json" --resource "**/*.node"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:win && npm run build:linux && npm run build:mac
